judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Breathless exclamations, the 'foul demoness' jab, potion-plus-spell reward and the ominous '...sooner than you think' tag match Nox's campaign quest-givers; the stilted 'darkest purposes, indeed!' could be either a period quirk or an imitator overreaching.
